text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
Is Tosen Jordan struggling?! Remaining to 
the finish line is—...

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: (—I can't believe it.)

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: (No, I really wish it was a lie.)

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
The Grand Prix crown goes to! In first 
place is...—

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: (――The front is so far away.)

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: *wheeze*... *gasp*...

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: (...What am I even babbling about?)

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
(...I mean, it's pretty crazy she can even 
talk after a race like that...)

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
"……Thus, I gained nourishment as well. I 
now understand the areas that require 
improvement."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Haaah... I was far too late in securing a 
good position. Next race, I must contest 
for positioning even if I have to push 
hard.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: They're just talkin' utter nonsense...

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: ...So this is the Arima Kinen, huh...

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
...Everyone is so smart and has so much 
stamina. And they talk about such 
complicated stuff.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Starting next year, I'll keep running with 
people like this. And this will become the 
norm.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: I lost, and kept on losing...

text_block_list.name: Gal Umamusumes
text_block_list.text: Jordan! Do your best!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Am I just gonna keep showing everyone how 
uncool I look...?

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
No, maybe their whole world is just 
different to begin with.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
—Before the concert. Tosen Jordan was 
wearing her school uniform instead of her 
concert outfit.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: ...Eh? Ah? I'm fine, but...?

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Ah...

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
H-Haha... It really is. That's hilarious. 
Guess I gotta go change.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Whoops, caught in the act☆ Well, out you 
go! I gotta change.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
"Or were you plannin' on peeking? Oh no~, 
I'm gonna sue☆ Come on, hurry on over to 
the door!"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
With Tosen Jordan pushing me from behind 
like that, I ended up getting kicked out 
of the room.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Ugh... I'm so lame...!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: —Quit daydreaming and face reality.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
I researched it properly, didn't I? I 
studied up in advance.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Palmer was already an amazing Umamusume 
even before the Arima.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Her stamina is insane. Her drive is insane 
too. She's so cool... and she even won the 
Takarazuka Kinen.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
I mean, it's obvious if you just think 
about it.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
"I'm not naturally talented like Helios 
is."

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
I'm not a quick-witted Umamusume who can 
do everything like City, either.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
If anything, I don't even have the brains 
to think things through properly like she 
does.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Haha... Ah, but does it feel like I got a 
little smarter?

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
...He... That Trainer really did a lot for 
my sake, but...

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
When it mattered most, I... I was the only 
one who couldn't...

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Haha... Honestly, why didn't I realize 
this until now?

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Ah... I'm such an idiot, seriously...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Together with Tosen Jordan, I head back to 
the academy from Nakayama Racecourse.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
While Tosen Jordan missed out on 1st place 
this time, it must have been a great 
learning experience. She'll surely achieve 
even better results next year.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: ! Huh. Wait, what was it again?

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Ah... that one. Ahh... mmm... well.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
...I'm just kind of tired. Sorry, maybe 
not today.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Goodbye, Trainer. Thank you for 
everything.

text_block_list.name: Gal Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
Jordan! About the after-party! Instead of 
a restaurant, wanna go hang out somewhere 
else?

text_block_list.name: Gal Umamusume B
text_block_list.text:
"My mom said she'd drive us! Told me I 
should relax on my days off."

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
"...Aaah, an after-party sounds great. 
Really feels like it's over now."

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: ...Well, it's over now.

text_block_list.name: Gal Umamusume C
text_block_list.text:
"...Jordan? Feelin' super wiped today? 
Should we just chat tomorrow?"

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: "...Ah. No. Umm. I mean I agree!"

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Let's go. Anywhere is fine by me!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
If I recall correctly, the goal Tosen 
Jordan has had for a while now is "to 
become big."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Taking that into consideration, the first 
leg of the Spring Senior Triple Crown— a 
2000m GⅠ race, which happens to be Tosen 
Jordan's best distance...
choice_data_list: If it's the "Osaka Hai," she'll also—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: —However...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
During the period leading up to the New 
Year's break. I had been putting together 
a training plan tailored for the Osaka Hai 
and, just in case, other GⅠ races, but...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Tosen Jordan didn't come even once.
